name: Jackery Explorer 1000 v2
summary: A 1070 Wh LiFePO4 power station with 1500 W rated AC output for a planned mix of lights, communications and compatible household loads.
description: For blackout planning, separate stored energy from the power an appliance needs at startup. This model offers more rated AC headroom than the RIVER 2 Pro, but it still requires a load plan. Choose the devices that matter, check their labels and leave room for startup demand rather than treating a portable battery as whole-home backup.

specs.label: Rated AC output
specs.value: 1500 W total across three 120 V, 60 Hz outlets; 3000 W surge

specs.label: USB outputs
specs.value: USB-C: 100 W and 30 W maximum; USB-A: 18 W maximum

specs.label: Charging inputs
specs.value: AC wall power, compatible solar and car charging; no USB-C input

specs.label: Solar input
specs.value: 16–60 V; 200 W maximum per port, 400 W total

pros: Three AC outlets share a 1500 W budget.
Wall, car and compatible solar charging provide different replenishment options.
cons: A 1500 W rating is not a whole-home power guarantee.
USB-C ports are outputs, not charging inputs.
Battery depletion and overload protection can interrupt power.
useCases: Prepare a written charging schedule for phones, radios and task lighting.
Evaluate individually verified appliance loads within the shared AC limit.
